name: Masters
overview: Scripture reveals that masters are entrusted with authority over their households and servants, as seen in Abraham’s command to his eldest servant to faithfully oversee his possessions. They are called to act justly and not to defraud or oppress their servants, avoiding harshness as the Egyptians did in their rigour. Masters are also responsible to lead their households in obedience to God, putting away idols and observing His commands, exemplified by Jacob’s exhortation to his household to cleanse themselves and worship God. This divine oversight underscores the expectation that masters govern with righteousness and godly fear.
